title: Normalized exact-derived constant-tower pullback square
statement: An ordinary sheaf class square with exact inverse-image functors and specified constant-diagram comparison induces the tower square for realized classes and the normalized derived integer and units boundary maps.

proof.text: Use congruence of derived inverse image and composition with the source realization equality and the units boundary equality to identify the left composite. Use congruence of composition with the integer boundary equality and the target realization equality to identify the right composite. The theorem constant_tower_derived_square gives equality of the two normalized composites. Transitivity gives the required equation, preserving the original single and shift comparisons.

lean.statement:
theorem normalized_integral_tower_square {X Y : Scheme.{u}}
    [hDiagY : HasDerivedCategory.{u + 1} (DiagonalAb Y)]
    [hDiagX : HasDerivedCategory.{u + 1} (DiagonalAb X)]
    [hAbY : HasDerivedCategory.{u + 2} (Ab Y)]
    [hAbX : HasDerivedCategory.{u + 2} (Ab X)]
    (d : NormalizedIntegralTowerSquare X Y) :
    d.P.mapDerivedCategory.map d.classY.towerClass ≫ d.uDerived =
      d.iDerived ≫ d.classX.towerClass
